Now about the food... it was really good. Due to Navratri days we ordered veg dishes but we were not disappointed at all. Loved the food and service too. featured_reviews.name: Mohit Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Fakht Chinese Team,

I wanted to share my positive experience with a recent order we placed that included noodles, rice, and several starters.

First off, the delivery arrived right on time. We were also very pleased with the generous portion sizes. Even the half-sized dishes were substantial enough for a full meal for one person.

Moving on to the most important part – the taste and quality – everything was absolutely scrumptious. All the dishes in your Indian Chinese section were perfectly prepared, incredibly tasty, and very satisfying.

We also appreciated the inclusion of disposable cutlery. In the past, we've had issues with other restaurants not providing these items even when requested, so it was a pleasant surprise that Fakht Chinese included them without us having to ask.

Overall, the taste and your service were outstanding. Cheers to your team, and please keep up the excellent work!

featured_reviews.name: The 7th Wanderer
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had visited this place on Saturday eve for a piping hot Soup as the weather was chilling & the following is my unbiased & honest review :

Location : At the Entry of Krishna Complex, available on google maps, not visible from the main road.

Place : Its located on the ground floor, I didnt know about this place until someone suggested me as I was looking for a chicken manchow soup in the area.

Ambience : Well Lit, Nothing too fancy, seating capacity is decent.

Staff : There was only 1 waiter catering to everyone but the service was quick enough. The waiter was polite and catered to all my questions patiently.

Food & Drinks : As the weather was chilling, i needed a piping hot chicken manchow soup and thats what I received. The quantity was good enough & filling and it tasted different, maybe as they dont add MSG (best part), its all mentioned in their menu. For drinks, i could only see some usual beverages in the refrigerator so i didnt bother asking.

Music : There were some good songs being played on the stereo.

Value For Money : Definately Yes ! All the asian cuisine lovers should try this place, im sure it would be worth it.

BitterSweet : None !

featured_reviews.name: K. “ContentName” F.
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our weekday dinner was underwhelming. The indoor seating felt cramped, with no space to add extra chairs, so we opted for outdoor seating instead.

Unfortunately, the red lighting outside created an unpleasant ambiance, distorting the appearance of every dish—a major downside. The Chicken Strips in Peri Peri are a must try. If you like cheese, the Chicken Dilkish kebabs are worth it. While the food was decent overall, nothing stood out as exceptional or memorable.

Service was just okay, but small details like unchilled fresh lime soda without ice were disappointing.

With no standout dishes or inviting atmosphere, I don’t feel inclined to revisit this spot. Good for a casual meal, but not worth going out of your way for.

Chicken Strips in Peri Peri 5/5 (delicious)
Chicken Banjara Kebab 3/5 (basic taste)
Chicken Dilkush Kebab 4/5 (stuffed with cheese)
Chicken Alishan Kebab 3/5 (basic taste)
Fresh Lime Soda 3/5 (Not chilled)

And that too when I have been a regular at this place since 2010, before even the current management took over.

Crispy Chicken – perfectly cooked, crunchy on the outside and juicy inside.

Chicken Fried Rice – my absolute favourite. Simple, clean flavours, yet very tasty. Sometimes simple done right is unbeatable.

The ambience is very nice—pleasant and welcoming. Considering it was only the second day since opening and the place was houseful, everything was handled really well.

Highly recommended. Do try it once—and thank me later 😉

Today I placed an order (through Zomato) for Veg Fried Rice, Paneer Crispy, and Mushroom Butter Garlic, and I wanted to share my experience.

The Veg Fried Rice and Paneer Crispy were good and met my expectations. However, the Mushroom Butter Garlic was extremely disappointing. The dish was essentially a thick, cornflour-based gravy with little to no visible mushrooms. The texture was unpleasantly gloopy, and it lacked flavor.

When I reached out to the restaurant, I was informed that this is the way the dish is always prepared, which was quite surprising given that this was far from the Mushroom Butter Garlic I was expecting / seen anytime before.

I’ve attached a photo of the delivered dish for comparison with what I believe the dish should have looked like.

Hope the restaurant takes it in a positive way and does the necessary changes in their recipe, if not people know what to avoid while ordering from here.

featured_reviews.name: Arjun Rampal Escovar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Kimling Chinese Restaurant recently and had a really good experience.
The food quality is impressive, especially if you’re craving Indo-Chinese flavors. The taste is consistent, well-balanced, and not overly oily like many places. The quantity is generous, making it perfect for sharing with friends or family.
What stands out the most is that it’s very reasonably priced, so you get great value for money without compromising on taste or portion size. The menu has a good variety of options—from classic noodles and fried rice to starters and gravies.
The place itself is simple and comfortable, ideal for a casual dine-out or takeaway. Service is fairly quick, and the staff is polite.
Overall, a great spot in Nalasopara/Vasai East for satisfying your Chinese food cravings without burning a hole in your pocket. Definitely worth visiting again!
